sloka: तस्य अयम् आश्रमो भ्रातुः तटाक वन शोभितः ।विप्र अनुकम्पया येन कर्म इदम् दुष्करम् कृतम् ॥३-११-६७॥
transliteration: tasya ayam āśramo bhrātuḥ taṭāka vana śobhitaḥ ।vipra anukampayā yena karma idam duṣkaram kṛtam ॥3-11-67॥

translations.english: Ilvala who pounced upon Agastya, the best among the sages whose lustre lay consumed by the fire of his eyes which were in flames.
